name: Wagtail Animal Clinic
tagline: A family-owned veterinary clinic for dogs and cats — unhurried exams, fear-free handling, and prices you can see before you sit down.
same_day_note: Sick today? Call before noon for a same-day visit.
emergency_label: After hours, call Northside Animal ER
license_note: Dr. Nora Ellis, DVM · Fear Free Certified Practice
fees_note: Prices are where a visit starts. We always give you an estimate before any treatment, and nothing is added without asking.

service_groups.name: Everyday care
service_groups.body: The visits that keep a healthy pet healthy.

service_groups.name: Sick & diagnostics
service_groups.body: When something is off, answers the same day.

service_groups.name: Surgery & dental
service_groups.body: Planned procedures, estimated in writing first.

triage.title: A check-up or vaccines
triage.body: Yearly exams, puppy and kitten series, and boosters — booked at a time that suits you.
triage.label: Book a wellness visit

triage.title: Something's not right today
triage.body: Limping, not eating, an upset stomach. We hold same-day slots every morning.
triage.label: Call (555) 318-2204

triage.title: It can't wait
triage.body: Trouble breathing, a suspected poisoning, or a seizure that won't stop. Go now.
triage.label: Northside Animal ER · (555) 410-9911

promises.title: Thirty-minute exams
promises.body: Time to sniff the room, settle, and ask every question — never a ten-minute rush.

promises.title: Fear-free handling
promises.body: Treats, non-slip mats, pheromone diffusers, and a separate quiet waiting room for cats.

promises.title: An estimate first
promises.body: You see the cost of any treatment before it starts, and you decide.

testimonial.quote: Biscuit used to shake in the parking lot. Now she pulls me through the door. They explained everything, and the bill matched the estimate to the dollar.
testimonial.name: Priya S.

art_direction.identity: The honest neighborhood vet: porcelain canvas, biscuit panels, deep navy type, one cobalt accent, warm natural-light pet photography. Calm and confident — never a cartoon paw-print site.
art_direction.type: Bricolage Grotesque (semibold, tight tracking) for every heading; Hanken Grotesk for body and UI. Big, friendly headlines; body stays at a comfortable reading size.
art_direction.color: One accent: cobalt (bg-primary) for the primary button, the prices in the fee chart, and small focal marks. Navy (bg-secondary) carries exactly one dark band — the visit and hours section. Everything else is canvas, biscuit surface, white cards, ink, and muted text. Never add another color.
art_direction.signature: The fee chart — services printed like a clinic's wall chart, with a Dog column and a Cat column of cobalt prices on hairline rules. Keep it wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Warm, plain, a little wry. Short sentences and real numbers. No exclamation marks, no 'fur babies', no vague promises.
